name: Tataouinea
sum: Tataouinea is a rebbachisaurid sauropod from the Early Cretaceous of Tunisia, noted for its extremely bird-like air-sac pneumatization.
wsnote: Size inferred by comparison with similar sauropods, not measured (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; excavated in 2012 from the Aïn el Guettar Formation.
material: Partial skeleton; further material of the holotype specimen was uncovered in 2015.
exceptional: Vertebrae with extensive air-sac pneumatization comparable to that of birds.
biology: Its vertebrae show air-sac related pneumatization of an extreme, bird-like kind.
author: Fanti et al. 2013
